name: dolowcool
description: A privacy-conscious message composer that pauses email actions until live pulse and breathing settle toward a personal baseline.
author: Agozie180

scripts.build: npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start:sim: npm run build && cross-env DOLOWCOOL_SOURCE=sim electron .
scripts.start:presage: npm run build && cross-env DOLOWCOOL_SOURCE=presage electron .
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && cross-env DOLOWCOOL_SOURCE=sim electron scripts/electron-smoke.js
scripts.test:presage-smoke: npm run build && cross-env DOLOWCOOL_SOURCE=presage SMARTSPECTRA_API_KEY= electron scripts/presage-smoke.js
